changed.title: At r ≥ 4 and k ≥ 5r - 2, the adjacency rule takes at most 11k² times 2^max(floor(k/2),5r - 3) fan-in-two AND/OR/NOT gates
changed.statement:
∀ (k r : Nat), 4 ≤ r → 5 * r - 2 ≤ k →
  let rot := fun (s word : Nat) =>
    ((word <<< (s % k)) ||| (word >>> (k - s % k))) % 2 ^ k
  let step := fun (word : Nat) =>
    (List.range k).foldl (fun acc i =>
      acc ||| ((xor (word.testBit i)
        (!(word.testBit ((i + 1) % k)) && word.testBit ((i + 2) % k))).toNat <<< i)) 0
  let constant := fun (j : Nat) => 3 ^ (k + j) % 2 ^ k
  let first := fun (rowKey rowName : Nat) =>
    (List.range r).foldl (fun rowState rowIndex =>
      step (rowState ^^^ rot 1 rowState ^^^ rot (k - 1) rowState) ^^^
        rot (2 * rowIndex) rowKey ^^^ constant (rowIndex + 1)) (rot 1 rowKey ^^^ rowName)
  let second := fun (colKey colName : Nat) =>
    (List.range r).foldl (fun colState colIndex =>
      step (colState ^^^ rot 2 colState ^^^ rot (k - 2) colState) ^^^
        rot (3 * (colIndex + 1) + 1) colKey ^^^ constant (r + (colIndex + 1)))
      (rot 3 colKey ^^^ colName)
  let h := (k + 1) / 2
  let graph : Fin (2 ^ k) → Fin (2 ^ k) → Bool := fun row col =>
    (List.range (2 ^ k)).any (fun w =>
      decide (first w row.val < 2 ^ (k - h)) && decide (second w col.val < 2 ^ (k - h)))
  ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (k + k) C ∧
    C.size ≤ 2 ^ (max (k - h) (5 * r - 3)) * (11 * k ^ 2) ∧
    ∀ bits : Fin (k + k) → Bool,
      C.eval (List.ofFn bits) = PEqualNP.Represents.adjFun (k := k) (l := k) graph bits
changed.unlocks: a ceiling for the candidate rule cut to r rounds for r from 4 while 5r - 2 is at most k, for the line that says which round counts are cheap
changed.context: On paper. The rule is the two-test rule written out in the statement. Set L = 5r - 3, h = ceil(k/2). In the starting row word x, round r at bit i reads only x[p+1..p+L], p = i-(2r-3); the last key addition adds x[p] XOR u[p]. Fix the L seed bits and sweep down the h tested bits. Solve each fresh pivot, then check repeated bits after the wrap. Guess untouched bits. Recover the key and run both tests per slot; OR the 2^max(k-h,L) slots. Charge at most 38kr + 8k + 5min(h,k-L) + 2h gates a slot, plus constants and the last OR. At k = 5r - 2 this is no better than trying every key.

changed.title: A perfect matching in 6-vertex graphs, on 15 edge bits: an AND/OR/NOT circuit of fan-in at most two with at most 30 gates
changed.unlocks: a calibration of our constructions for this function
changed.context: Answer with a circuit, not an argument: a gate list (operation, wires read; wires 0 to n-1 are the input bits in the order the statement names, gate j writes wire n+j, each gate reads only earlier wires) and the output wire. Judged by one kernel evaluation over every input. A calibration of our constructions; no claim attached either way. We hold 34 gates (no NOT gate), built as vertex 0 matched to each other vertex in turn, the matchings of the remaining four vertices shared; we do not know whether 30 exists. 15 inputs: use the column replay pattern.

changed.unlocks: one entry on how few one-colour rectangles cover the 0-entries or 1-entries of a named small matrix (plane incidence, inner product, a graph's complement): the cover number that communication bounds rest on
